label: Lower back — weak erectors/core + running-specific tightening (PRIORITY build)
description: Painless positional/endurance limit (back loses neutral hold in rows/squats before prime movers fail) + erector/QL tightening specifically after ~3 min running; old acute lumbar 'pop' years ago, fully healed; tolerates all loaded lifting/martial-arts pain-free.
intake_questions: Does it ever radiate or go numb/tingly?
Improving with the strengthening over weeks?
workaround: NOT an avoidance — a PRIORITY weak-point to BUILD: emphasize erector + glute strength & endurance (RDL, good-morning, 45-deg back-ext substitutes, loaded carries) and anti-flexion/anti-extension/anti-rotation core bracing; build hip-hinge competency + hip mobility. Monitor (painless = continue). Schedule heavy hinge Wed->Thu-rest, keep clear of krav/kickboxing days.
notes: Physio assessment recommended for the running-specific piece (deferred). Functional/painless; a build priority, not a loading gate.

label: Right wrist tendinopathy (chronic, currently quiet)
description: Long-standing low-grade wrist tendonitis; not currently an issue.
workaround: Favor neutral-grip variants; allow wrist wraps; prefer machine/cable where the wrist stays neutral; FTS cuffs bypass grip. No restriction while quiet — monitor.

label: Right shoulder painless crepitus on overhead press (old instability/biceps hx)
description: Shoulder cracks on overhead press — painless, never symptomatic; old clinician note of biceps detachment/instability.
workaround: Painless => no restriction. Favor shoulder-friendly press variants (neutral-grip DB, landmine, incline) over strict heavy barbell overhead; emphasize rotator-cuff + scapular-stability work. Get assessed before loading heavy strict overhead.

label: TMJ — avoid jaw clenching on heavy/valsalva sets
intake_questions: Does clenching under load flare it?
workaround: Cue: keep jaw relaxed / use a mouthguard on heavy or max-effort sets; avoid hard clenching. Jaw treatment is out-of-scope (future health domain / dentist).

label: Left pinky — intermittent jam on crush-grip/weight-hanging (TEMPORARY)
description: Left pinky feels on the edge of a jam when load hangs from the closed hand (DB calf raises, suitcase carries, overhead DB extensions). Short-term / temporary.
workaround: Grip-bypass: cable wrist cuffs (FTS — confirmed work), lifting straps, machine-loaded variants; avoid hanging heavy DBs from the closed hand.
notes: TEMPORARY — flip active=false when it resolves.
